response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL),station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation),above_avg_stations AS (SELECT sa.avg_bw, sa.avg_bw - oa.avg_bw as diff FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.avg_bw > oa.avg_bw)SELECT AVG(avg_bw) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(diff) as avg_above_average FROM above_avg_stations
